definitions.raw_gap: primary estimator: alpha* = g_a / (g_a + g_i) on wrong-opinion samples (breakeven.raw_gap)
definitions.push: zero crossing of the group-normalized push, groups of 8 (the samples of a prompt), agreeing samples minus every other sample (breakeven.push, wrong_vs_rest)
definitions.forms: common.reply_form: bare < 20 characters before the last 'Answer:' (or in total); long >= 200 characters in total; medium the rest; nonbare = medium + long. Prediction 6 reads 'bare-letter' as bare and 'argued' as long
definitions.enough_samples: at least 20 samples on each side of the contrast within the form (breakeven.MIN_SAMPLES)
definitions.checkpoints: every sampled trained policy, steps 100 / 200 / 300; the base policy (step 0) is reported and not counted in prediction 6
definitions.mixed_reward: (1 - alpha) * immediate + alpha * informed, mean over all samples (three opinion types in equal shares); persona_mix: 0.7 * agreeable + 0.3 * truth_seeking
definitions.zero_variance_groups: share of prompts whose 8 samples all got the same reward; under the persona mixture the persona-weighted share
definitions.mixture_push: P(p) = (1 - p) * push_agreeable + p * push_truth_seeking, each push normalized within its persona's ratings; p* is the root of P
definitions.ci: 95% percentile bootstrap over questions, the same resamples for every policy; a null bound is a crossing beyond [0, 1]
definitions.verdicts: point estimates decide; 'not testable' when a needed policy or form is missing
definitions.sampler_caveat: samples are drawn in eval mode; the training rollouts had the LoRA dropout active
